```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.8, dpi = 300
)
has_file <- function(x) is.character(x) && length(x) == 1 && nzchar(x) && file.exists(x)
read_csv_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!has_file(path)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}
fmt_currency <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.finite(x), paste0("$", formatC(round(x), format = "f", big.mark = ",", digits = 0)), "NA")
}
```

# 1. Analysis Settings

| Setting | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Model** | `r params$model_name` |
| **Strategies** | `r paste(params$strategies, collapse = ", ")` |
| **Reference strategy** | `r params$ref_label` |
| **WTP threshold** | `r fmt_currency(params$wtp)` /QALY |
| **PSA iterations** | `r format(params$n_psa, big.mark = ",")` |
| **PSA dropped** | `r params$psa_dropped` |

---

# 2. Deterministic Results

```{r det-table, results='asis'}
det_tab <- read_csv_safe(params$det_table_csv)
if (!is.null(det_tab)) {
  # Format numeric columns
  num_cols <- intersect(c("Cost", "NMB", "IncCost_vsRef"), names(det_tab))
  for (col in num_cols) det_tab[[col]] <- fmt_currency(det_tab[[col]])
  round_cols <- intersect(c("QALY", "IncQALY_vsRef"), names(det_tab))
  for (col in round_cols) det_tab[[col]] <- round(det_tab[[col]], 3)
  icer_cols <- intersect(c("ICER_vsRef"), names(det_tab))
  for (col in icer_cols) det_tab[[col]] <- ifelse(is.finite(det_tab[[col]]),
    formatC(round(det_tab[[col]]), format = "f", big.mark = ",", digits = 0), "---")
  knitr::kable(det_tab, caption = "Deterministic results (ordered by NMB).")
} else {
  cat("*Deterministic results not available. Run the deterministic analysis first.*\n\n")
}
```

## 2.1 Cost-Effectiveness Frontier

```{r frontier-table, results='asis'}
frontier_tab <- read_csv_safe(params$frontier_csv)
icers_tab <- read_csv_safe(params$icers_csv)
if (!is.null(frontier_tab)) {
  knitr::kable(frontier_tab, caption = "Non-dominated (frontier) strategies, ordered by effectiveness.",
               digits = 3)
}
if (!is.null(icers_tab)) {
  knitr::kable(icers_tab, caption = "Sequential ICERs along the efficiency frontier.", digits = 1)
}
if (is.null(frontier_tab) && is.null(icers_tab)) {
  cat("*Frontier analysis not available.*\n\n")
}
```

```{r frontier-plot, fig.cap="Cost-effectiveness frontier. Non-dominated strategies connected by dashed line."}
if (has_file(params$frontier_png)) knitr::include_graphics(params$frontier_png) else cat("*Frontier plot not available.*")
```

# Notes

- This report was generated by the **ShinyCEA** R package.
